relation.desc: البدر حسن بن محب الدين الطرابلسي
relation.note: He succeeded Khalīl al-Tawrīzī as the deputy governor of Alexandria in 816 AH or after.

event.desc: He was dismissed from the deputy governorship of Alexandria (niyābat al-Iskandariyya) and replaced by al-Badr Ḥasan b. Muḥibb al-Dīn al-Ṭarābulusī.

person.note: ハリル・アッ＝タウリーズィー、アレクサンドリアの副知事。アッ＝シュジャーリーとして知られる。ヒジュラ暦816年あるいはそれ以降に、アル＝バドル・ハサン・ビン・ムヒブ・アッ＝ディーン・アッ＝タラーブルスィーの任官に伴い、副知事職を解任された。

Khalīl al-Tawrīzī, the deputy governor of Alexandria, known as al-Shajārī. He was separated from his office as deputy governor in the year 816 AH or after, being replaced by al-Badr Ḥasan b. Muḥibb al-Dīn al-Ṭarābulusī.
